message: duplicate node id V_id in workflow V_wf: first at V_first, again at V_second
why: Node ids are array indices (IR.md §4). Two nodes sharing one id make every reference to it ambiguous — a kid that says V_id could mean either of them, and which one you get depends on traversal order.
fix: renumber the node at V_second (ids must stay contiguous, 0..V_last)
or delete one of the two nodes if it is a leftover
